title: Rebuild the stock rear brake master cylinder
completeness: Complete stock rear-master cylinder kit replacement with pedal joint, mounting and hose refit, fluid replacement and bleeding. Caliper, wheel and hose remain otherwise serviceable.
entry_state: Assembled exact US2023 stock YZ450F with serviceable rear caliper, hose, disc and pedal.
Exact rear master-cylinder kit, new split pin and union washers available.
exit_state: Rear master rebuilt and mounted; pedal joint retained and adjusted.
Rear circuit bled and reservoir closed; leak, pedal and brake-effect checks passed.

source.review_note: Exact2023 source and all instruction/verification content independently reviewed by root; author diagram/text audit complete. Source mechanics unchanged after independent review.

applicability.included: Stock rear master cylinder on exact US2023 YZ450F
excluded: Damaged master-cylinder body or other brake components requiring replacement

required_tools.name: Stable support, suitable hand tools and precision torque tools
Retaining-ring tools and clean parts tray

required_parts.name: Exact new rear master-cylinder kit
required_parts.purpose: Renew piston assembly, pushrod, circlip and boot marked NEW on153

preflight: Use exact cup/retention diagrams154/159/160 and pedal reference153.
Protect eyes and painted/plastic surfaces from fluid.
critical_stop_conditions: Damaged bore/body, incorrect kit or unseated retention.
Fluid leaks, persistent air, soft pedal, brake drag or improper braking.

steps.title: Prepare and drain
steps.instruction: Secure bike upright on level ground with reservoir horizontal. Protect surfaces. Remove rear cap, diaphragm plate and diaphragm; connect caliper bleeder to catch hose/container and drain fluid with pedal/bleeder cycle.
steps.verification: Circuit drained before master removal; discard old fluid.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Remove master
steps.instruction: Disconnect master union and discard both copper washers; catch remaining fluid. Remove split pin, washer and joint pin. Remove master mounting bolts and master.
steps.verification: Retain reusable joint hardware; discard old split pin.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Strip cylinder kit
steps.instruction: Remove joint and its adjustment hardware from pushrod in diagram 147 order. Remove boot and circlip while controlling spring-loaded piston; withdraw pushrod, piston and spring. Preserve body bore.
steps.verification: Old kit removed; joint arrangement recorded.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Inspect and clean
steps.instruction: Replace master for body damage/scratches/wear. Inspect cap, diaphragm plate and diaphragm for cracks/damage; inspect hose for cracks/wear. Clear blocked passages with air. Clean internals using fresh DOT 4, never solvent.
steps.verification: Record findings; failed parts replaced before assembly.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Build new piston
steps.instruction: Lubricate new primary/secondary cups with DOT 4 and fit in the distinct positions/orientations shown on 152. Fit spring with smaller inside diameter toward piston.
steps.verification: Record both cup orientations and spring direction against diagram.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Install new kit
steps.instruction: Apply DOT 4 to piston assembly and bore; silicone grease to pushrod end. Install new piston assembly, new pushrod, new circlip and new boot in diagram 153 order. Fully seat retaining ring and boot; restore joint hardware from 147.
steps.verification: All NEW-marked parts renewed; piston retained and joint fitted.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Mount and connect pedal
steps.instruction: Install master mounting bolts 10 Nm. Connect pedal joint with pin, washer and new split pin; secure pin as diagram 146. Set pedal to the 5 mm reference shown there using adjusting bolt; tighten adjustment locknut 6 Nm.
steps.verification: Record mounting torque, pedal position and locknut torque; new split pin secured.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Reconnect master hose
steps.instruction: Fit two new copper washers; position hose pipe against the stop shown on 153 and tighten union 30 Nm. Preserve original route without strain.
steps.verification: Record washers, diagram stop contact and30 Nm.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Fill for bleeding
steps.instruction: Fill horizontal reservoir above the minimum mark shown on PDF 103 with fresh DOT 4 and fit diaphragm. Secure clear hose to bleeder and lead to catch container. Prevent water entry, overflow and reservoir running dry.
steps.verification: Correct fluid; sufficient supply throughout bleeding.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Bleed rear circuit
steps.instruction: Slowly pump pedal several times, then press fully and hold. Open bleeder; close before releasing pedal. Repeat until hose fluid is bubble-free, replenishing reservoir. If tiny bubbles persist, let fluid settle a few hours and repeat.
steps.verification: Record bubble-free fluid and firm pedal.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Close reservoir
steps.instruction: Tighten bleeder 5 Nm and refit cap. Restore fluid above the minimum mark shown on PDF 103 with bike upright and reservoir horizontal. Refit diaphragm, plate and cap in diagram 146 order; cap screws 1.5 Nm. Clean all spills.
steps.verification: Record final fluid level and closure torques.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Check wheel and brake
steps.instruction: Apply rear brake repeatedly and inspect hose/connections for leaks. Confirm firm pedal, correct pedal position and no brake drag. A soft pedal requires further bleeding. After stationary checks pass, check rear brake effect on a dry test surface.
steps.verification: Record no leaks, firm pedal, no drag and proper brake effect.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion checked against exact2023 BHR pages; closed hydraulic access and observation records are explicit workflow adaptations.
